name: 黏土定格
description: 圆润手捏形体带指纹与接缝，哑光表面和柔光体现温暖定格质感。
rendering_prompt: Shape the subject as a hand-molded clay object with rounded, slightly asymmetric forms. Preserve small fingerprints, dents, seams, and kneading marks. Colors should seem intrinsic to colored clay, with a matte finish and only a little warm, oily sheen. Use soft lighting and realistic contact shadows to reveal the thickness of a small physical object, conveying the warm, slightly awkward handmade character of stop-motion animation.
avoid: 光滑塑料、毛绒纤维、自动Q版化
difference: 黏土定格保留原比例；Q 版黏土额外压缩比例；毛毡有短纤维
tuning: 在关键转折处保留手塑痕迹，以温柔棚光表现材料。
